crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show…
and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs…
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these…
then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it…
He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do…
Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

parallels.note: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and…
that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

translations.web: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
translations.bsb: Tell it to your children; let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.
translations.kjv: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
translations.asv: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
